en.footer: Robo Study · A robotics engineering textbook
en.homeDescription: A robotics engineering textbook for software developers, from first principles to simulated projects and field engineering.
en.headline: Robotics from first principles.
en.intro: No robotics background required. Start with a Python robot loop, then work through motion, sensing, autonomy, deployment, and the practice of building reliable robots.
en.figureAlt: Schematic of a two-joint arm with a base coordinate frame and an end-effector coordinate frame.
en.core: Read the common core, then choose a role and build a project.

zh-CN.footer: Robo Study · 机器人系统工程教材
zh-CN.homeDescription: 面向软件开发者的机器人系统工程教材，从基础原理讲到仿真项目与现场工程实践。
zh-CN.headline: 从基本原理学机器人
zh-CN.intro: 不需要机器人基础。先用 Python 写出一个闭环控制程序，再学习运动、感知、自主决策、部署，以及如何构建可靠的机器人系统。
zh-CN.figureAlt: 双关节机械臂示意图，标出了基座坐标系和末端执行器坐标系。
zh-CN.core: 先学共通基础，再选一个方向，动手完成一个项目。
